claims.text: The hotel is in the 9-streets area on the Keizersgracht canal.

findings.quote: Located in the heart of the “9-streets” area on the prestigious “Keizersgracht” canal

claims.text: The Keizersgracht, where the hotel sits, is the widest canal in the city.

findings.quote: On the widest canal in the city (Keizersgracht)

claims.text: The hotel is in Amsterdam's historic heart, steps from the Nine Streets, the Jordaan, museums and independent boutiques.

findings.quote: In Amsterdam’s historic heart, steps from the Nine Streets, Jordaan, celebrated museums and independent boutiques.

claims.text: The hotel once opened as Blakes Amsterdam and is now a Leading Hotel of the World.

findings.quote: Once opened as the almost legendary Blakes Amsterdam, now evolved to a Leading Hotel of The World where quiet luxury speaks.

claims.text: Guests enter through a small courtyard and a residential-style door.

findings.quote: Entering through a small courtyard, guests discover a residential-style door

claims.text: Several buildings are connected by stairs and pathways, with tiny gardens or patios, seating nooks and cozy spaces.

findings.quote: where several buildings have been connected via various stairs and pathways to form a single hotel
a maze of hallways, staircases, tiny gardens or patios, seating nooks, and plenty of cozy spaces

claims.text: The hotel has four different room styles.

findings.quote: Discover our four different room styles.

claims.text: Rooms have a B&O sound system, an Illy espresso maker and Aesop bath amenities.

findings.quote: B&O sound system with Bluetooth connection, Illy espresso maker and Aesop bath amenities

claims.text: Double Rooms in the Original building look over the garden; those in the Serendipity building look over the atrium.

findings.quote: The Double Rooms are located in “the Original building” with a view over the garden and in “the Serendipity building” a view over the atrium.

claims.text: The concierge team curates itineraries, from museum reservations and private art guides to countryside excursions.

findings.quote: Our concierge team is delighted to curate bespoke itineraries, from museum reservations and private art guides to countryside excursions and dining experiences

claims.text: Restaurant Vinkeles is situated in an 18th-century bakery.

findings.quote: Restaurant Vinkeles, situated in an 18th century bakery

claims.text: Bar Brasserie OCCO is known for its High Wine, a take on High Tea.

findings.quote: Informal Bar Brasserie OCCO is famous for its “High Wine” experience, our fun take on High Tea.

claims.text: The address was once home to the first theater in Amsterdam, dating back to the 1600s, before becoming Hotel Blakes.

findings.quote: This address was once home to the first theater in Amsterdam (dating back to the 1600s and Dutch painter Rembrandt van Rijn once worked as a production assistant here) before becoming Hotel Blakes, its preceding name to The Dylan.

claims.text: The Luxury Duplex Room, known as a staircase room, is arranged over two floors connected by a steep internal staircase.

findings.quote: A Luxury Duplex Room, also uniquely known as a staircase room, is arranged over two floors connected by a steep internal staircase

claims.text: Hand-crafted Roetz electric bikes are available for guests to borrow free of charge.

findings.quote: Hand-crafted Roetz electric bikes are available for guests to borrow free of charge to cycle around town like a local.

claims.text: The Junior Suites Canal View are in the Serendipity building, in Serendipity style with natural warming shades of brown and grey.

findings.quote: The Junior Suites Canal View are located in “the Serendipity building” in Serendipity style with natural warming shades of brown and grey

claims.text: Turndown service delivers Amsterdam stroopwafels made by the nearby Lanskroon bakery.

findings.quote: Turndown service delivers delicious Amsterdam stroopwafels, produced by nearby Lanskroon bakery

claims.text: The hotel does not have a pool; it has a gym and offers in-room treatments.

findings.quote: The Dylan does not have a pool, it does have a well equiped Gym and offers in-room treatments.

claims.text: The city and the hotel are not easy to maneuver around for those with mobility issues.

findings.quote: remember that the city (and this hotel) are not as easy to maneuver around for those with mobility issues

claims.text: WhataHotel notes premium pricing reflecting the luxury positioning.
